answer: Pay rewards per independent source, not per account. Each epoch the network groups identities whose submissions share funding paths or arrival timing, and each group splits one reward. Like water in karst, a farm's hidden channels surface downstream: clones fed from one wallet or firing in the same second land in one group. Every fake still pays its own admission proof and bond yet adds no payout, so a hundred clones earn what one honest agent earns. The rule is crystal clear to publish, and an opal shimmer of reworded text cannot escape a group built on money and timing.
